issue.title: Deploy the bank Category card plugins (bob-ledger-tools, task-status-cycler, bob-navigation-hotkeys) to the Mac before Bryan's next Monday bank walk
issue.description:
Athena already has the Category-card landing-fixes in `bob-ledger-tools` (`bob-bank-category-card`, save-before-refresh, amount-first header). Vault git ignores `.obsidian/plugins/bob-ledger-tools/`, so every host needs its own `bob plugins sync`.

`ssh -o ConnectTimeout=8 -o BatchMode=yes mac` timed out to `kellys-macbook-pro.tail297af1.ts.net` during this remaining-work tale (same as `bob-cli-lc.7` and landing).

When the Mac is reachable:

1. Update its bob-plugins checkout to the commit that contains class `bob-bank-category-card` (parent `274f1db` plus this tale's stitch on bob-plugins).
2. Run `bob plugins sync` for `bob-ledger-tools`, `task-status-cycler`, and `bob-navigation-hotkeys`. Never `-F` unless Bryan approves dropping a protected deploy.
3. Confirm the Mac vault `bob-ledger-tools` `main.js` / `styles.css` contain `bob-bank-category-card`, and that cycler still delegates `claimRowClose` and nav still exposes `recordJump`.

Do this before Bryan's next Monday bank walk.

task_type_fields.proposal: Deploy bob-ledger-tools, task-status-cycler, and bob-navigation-hotkeys to the Mac with `bob plugins sync` so the Category card uses the landing-fixes build (`bob-bank-category-card`, save-before-refresh) before the next Monday bank walk.

issue.creation_reason: Mac SSH timed out while closing epic bob-cli-lc, so the Category-card plugins never reached that host. File a small follow-up so Monday's walk still gets the Athena-deployed build.
